description: This file defines command-line commands and related classes for GN build system, including command registration, execution functions, command switches, and target filtering utilities.

classes.name: CommandInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a command, including help text and the function to run it.

classes.name: CommandSwitches
classes.description: Models a set of command-line flags and values affecting GN command outputs.

methods.name: target_print_mode()
methods.description: Returns the current target print mode.

methods.name: target_type()
methods.description: Returns the current target output type.

methods.name: Init(const base::CommandLine&)
methods.description: Initializes command switches from command line arguments.

methods.name: Get()
methods.description: Retrieves the current global command switches.

methods.name: Set(CommandSwitches)
methods.description: Sets the global command switches and returns the previous set.

methods.name: ResolveTargetFromCommandLineString(Setup*, const std::string&)
methods.description: Resolves a target label string to a Target object.

methods.name: ResolveFromCommandLineInput(Setup*, const std::vector<std::string>&, bool, UniqueVector<const Target*>*, UniqueVector<const Config*>*, UniqueVector<const Toolchain*>*, UniqueVector<SourceFile>*)
methods.description: Resolves command line inputs to targets, configs, toolchains, or files.

FilterTargetsByPatterns(const std::vector<const Target*>&, const std::vector<LabelPattern>&, std::vector<const Target*>*)

methods.description: Filters targets matching patterns into a UniqueVector.

methods.name: FilterOutTargetsByPatterns(const std::vector<const Target*>&, const std::vector<LabelPattern>&, std::vector<const Target*>*)
FilterPatternsFromString(const BuildSettings*, const std::string&, std::vector<LabelPattern>*, Err*)

methods.name: FilterAndPrintTargets(bool, std::vector<const Target*>*)
methods.description: Filters and prints targets based on command line flags.

methods.name: FilterAndPrintTargets(std::vector<const Target*>*, base::ListValue*)

methods.name: FilterAndPrintTargetSet(bool, const TargetSet&)
methods.description: Filters and prints a set of targets.

methods.name: FilterAndPrintTargetSet(const TargetSet&, base::ListValue*)
